policy: Source identifies inputs. Mass-retention and carrier-volume calculations are curator-defined planning models, not reported experimental yields. User-entered recovery remains an assumption.

models.label: Nominal carrier-liquid volume
models.scope: Assumes the entered carrier liquid is retained. Actual recovered volume and silver nanoparticle mass are unreported; rinsing and target dimensions do not count as product volume.

models.label: Graphite-derived product mass ceiling
models.scope: Input graphite mass only, at hypothetical full retention. This is an upper bound, not measured exfoliation yield; solvent and steel milling media are excluded.

models.label: PLGA plus drug core-mass ceiling
models.scope: Hypothetical complete PLGA and drug retention. Entrapment, particle recovery and retained PVA are unreported, so this is a selected core-solids ceiling, not measured total particle yield.
models.source_locator: Methods for synthesis of PLGA MPs/NPs; PDF p4

models.label: Lignin-derived product mass ceiling
models.scope: Input lignin mass at hypothetical full retention. Actual dialysis recovery is unreported; DMSO and dialysis water are excluded.
models.source_locator: Experimental: Fabrication and characterization of lignin nanoparticles, PDF pp 8-9
